title: Jagged Spicy Egyptian Red Snapper Bowl
description: A spicy and indulgent Egyptian dish featuring red snapper, served in a stone bowl, and shojin-friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Egypt with the simplicity of a bowl dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the red snapper fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the red snapper fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Cook over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the berbere spice and tomato paste to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
